summary: Merge dependency is satisfied and migration risk is low, but producer deployment, scoped redispatch, release target ordering, operator recovery, and rollback evidence need clarification or remediation before merge.

findings.detail: Verify Eve producer deployment and runtime SHA before the Brainbase consumer merge.
Provide a safe run-id lookup and dispatch only the run corresponding to msrc_4f7c995f.
Record producer deployment and Brainbase runtime deployment as separate ordered operations.
Document the operator recovery procedure for candidate failures.
Use a tested consumer revert/rollback procedure rather than the broad reconciler disable switch.
